summary: Solo 59-year-old pilot's experimental Kitfox IV-1200 (N125TY) struck a USGS cableway spanning the Colorado River while flying low near Loma; lost control and crashed into the river canyon, aircraft coming to rest partially submerged; passing river rafters pulled the conscious, minor-injured pilot from the wreck and brought him to the Westwater, Utah boat ramp; helicopter-transported to hospital
location: Colorado River near Loma (USGS cableway crossing)
responding_agency: Mesa County Sheriff's Office; Mesa County Search and Rescue; Lower Valley Fire Protection District
notes: NTSB accident CEN18LA303, ~11:30 a.m. MDT; departed Grand Junction Regional Airport ~11:00 bound for Cedar City UT; MCSO deputies took a boat upriver to secure the aircraft; MCSO notified FAA and NTSB
